reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in our direct message: he should keep Tuesday 10 Nov at 10:15 free for the Driftwood call.

That time comes from what he told me in our direct message on 14 Oct: his standing call with the Tamsin Cold Chain team for the Driftwood rollout had moved to Tuesdays at 10:15. I couldn't find a calendar invite for it, and nothing in #north-team or our direct messages says the time has changed since then. I suggested he check the invite if he has one.
